reuse.why: Hooks into the existing pre-link guard every provider already calls, though it writes its own SELECT instead of the existing db.getAccount helper.

duplication.why: The closed-account check is written once and shared by all six link handlers.

placement.why: The check sits in the pre-mutation guard layer of accounts/app.ts so nothing is touched before it, but it lives inside a function named ensureBankAccountIsNotLinked whose name no longer describes it.

scope.why: Only the guard and two focused tests change.

maintainability.why: Small and easy to follow; a separate, clearly named guard (or renaming the existing one) would make the two link preconditions more discoverable.

bypasses_abstraction.where: uses an inline db.first query rather than db.getAccount, a minor convenience bypass, not a layering one

one_place.where: server/accounts/app.ts ensureBankAccountIsNotLinked, called by every link<Provider>Account handler before linkBankSyncAccount
